summary: Comprehensive Playwright UI test of the Hot Live 95 DJ Playout Studio (client-only React app). All 12 requested feature flows exercised end-to-end at the preview URL. Backend intentionally skipped per request. Everything works: playlist create/switch, WAV upload with computed durations, playback (play/pause/next/prev/seek), remove, replace, drag reorder, second playlist isolation, settings toggles (autoplay, crossfade + seconds select, volume, mute), and persistence across full page reload (localStorage + IndexedDB).

issues: Row action buttons (remove/replace) rely on opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 which requires hovering the row first; keyboard users cannot reach them. Non-blocking but a11y concern.

critical_code_review_comments: PlayerBar crossfade-seconds <select> is fine but the Emergent instrumentation injects a <span> inside <option> causing a benign React hydration warning in the console. Not caused by app code; ignore.
readDuration() in App.js constructs a hidden <audio>; on error it resolves 0 which would render '--:--'. Works for tested WAVs but a large corrupted file could leave duration=0.

cleanupTracks calls setTracks and platform.deleteFile inside the setter; deleteFile side-effect inside a state updater is acceptable in browser (no-op) but consider moving it outside for React 18 strict-mode double-invoke safety.
Persistence uses localStorage for metadata + IndexedDB for blobs; verified survives reload. No quota handling if user imports many/large files - consider size guard.
seed_data_creation: Generated 4 tiny 1-second mono 22.05kHz WAV files at /tmp/wavs/{alpha,beta,gamma,replacement}.wav using python wave module for upload tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully client-side; use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as preview URL. All data-testid attributes match the review request. drag_to() on Playwright reliably triggers the HTML5 dnd handlers here. Small locally-generated WAV files under /tmp/wavs/ work for upload; readDuration resolves correctly (~1s).
